vabb.operator.quote: Mumbai International Airport Limited, 1st Floor, Terminal - 1,

vabb.location.v: 14 km from Mumbai Central railway station (bearing 021.5°)
vabb.location.quote: 021.5 DEG, 14Km from Mumbai Central Railway station

vabb.slots.v: non-scheduled operators must file a slot request with the airport operations control centre (AOCC); all non-scheduled and general aviation movements need positive approval
vabb.slots.quote: Non Scheduled Aircraft operators are required to file their slot request with aocc.planning@adani.com for clearance.

vabb.ppr.v: requests for international movements at least 72 hours ahead, domestic at least 12 hours ahead
vabb.ppr.quote: Request for International movement must be forwarded at least 72hrs in advance.

vabb.notable.v: no general aviation between 08:00-10:00 and 17:00-19:30 local time daily (0230-0430 and 1130-1400 UTC); only VIP and scheduled flights then

vabb.notable_night.v: night flying is subject to other restrictions for non-scheduled flights
vabb.notable_night.quote: Night flying shall be subject to other restrictions applicable for the operation of non-scheduled flights

vabb.handling.v: hangar space at Air India and Jet Airways hangars subject to availability; no handling agents named
vabb.handling.quote: At Air India (NACIL) and Jet Airways Hanger subject to availability.

jp.authority.v: Civil Aviation Bureau, Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (MLIT); applications go to its International Aviation Division
jp.authority.quote: 国土交通省 航空局 航空ネットワーク部 国際航空課 国際運送係

jp.permit.v: a foreign aircraft flying to or from Japan needs an Article 126 permit, applied for 10 days before the flight
jp.permit.quote: 航行の予定期日の１０日前まで

jp.permit_paid.v: carrying paying passengers to or from Japan needs an Article 130-2 permit: 30 days ahead, 10 days if the operator has an office or agent in Japan, and 3 days (72 hours) for business, medical or tourism trips with an office or agent in Japan
jp.permit_paid.quote: 商用目的、医療目的又は観光目的の場合は3日(72時間)前

jp.overflight.v: crossing Japanese airspace needs the same permit unless the aircraft flies only on airways
jp.overflight.quote: 但、航空路のみを航行する場合は、申請は不要。

jp.cabotage.v: domestic legs need an Article 127 permit (free carriage, 3 days ahead); passengers may not board for a domestic leg only
jp.cabotage.quote: 国内区間のみの搭乗は認められないので注意すること。

jp.customs_airports.v: landing at an airport not designated by the Minister needs a separate permit
jp.customs_airports.quote: 国土交通大臣の指定する空港等（一覧表参照）以外において

jp.notable.v: chartered capacity may not be resold; flying without a permit can mean prison or a fine
jp.notable.quote: チャーターした部分の全部又は一部を、直接的又は間接的に転売又は販売しないこと。

kr.authority.v: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport (MOLIT)
kr.authority.quote: Administrator of Regional Office of Aviation, Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport

kr.permit.v: a foreign charter (non-scheduled commercial) flight needs a Foreign Non-scheduled International Air Transport Permission at least 10 days ahead (16 days for a military airport)
kr.permit.quote: at least 10 days(in case of military airport: 16 days) before the intended date of operation.

kr.permit_private.v: a private (non-commercial) flight applies to the Regional Office of Aviation at least 2 days ahead (16 days for a military airport)
kr.permit_private.quote: at least 2 days(in case of military airport : 16 days) before the intended date of operation.

kr.overflight.v: an overflight permit request goes to the Air Traffic Management Office 2 days ahead
kr.overflight.quote: shall submit an overflight permit request application to the Air Traffic Management Office(ATMO)

kr.customs_airports.v: international flights must first land at or finally depart from a designated international airport
kr.customs_airports.quote: must first land at or finally depart from the designated international airport

kr.notable.v: a permit is valid for ±24 hours; a new permit is needed if the time moves outside that window or the aircraft or call sign changes
kr.notable.quote: Validation of permit is ±24 hours for civil aircraft

tw.authority.quote: 民用航空局航空站 Airport Office, CAA

tw.permit.v: a foreign charter flight applies to the CAA 10 working days before departure; a private flight needs a CAA permit
tw.permit.quote: must be filed with the CAA, 10 working days before estimated departure date.

tw.permit_private.v: other non-scheduled and private flights apply 2 working days before entry
tw.permit_private.quote: 2 workdays prior to the proposed date of entry.

tw.overflight.v: non-scheduled transit flights submit to the Taipei Area Control Center 1 working day ahead
tw.overflight.quote: 1 working day in advance of the date of proposed operation.

tw.customs_airports.v: first landing and final departure at Taoyuan, Kaohsiung or other authorised aerodromes
tw.customs_airports.quote: Taipei/Taiwan Taoyuan International Aerodrome, Kaohsiung International Aerodrome, or other authorized aerodromes

tw.notable.v: an applicant without scheduled operations or a local general agent must appoint a local airline approved for international operations
tw.notable.quote: shall be delegated to a local civil air transport enterprise who is approved to conduct international operations.

tw.notable_law.v: the national rules ask for the application 2 working days before entry or exit
tw.notable_law.quote: 於入境或出境二工作日前向民航局申請核准

in.authority.quote: it is necessary for the operator to apply and obtain prior approval of DGCA.

in.permit.v: non-scheduled flights into, from or over India need prior DGCA approval, applied for 3 working days ahead for flights carrying traffic
in.permit.quote: Three working days for flights for traffic purposes; except as stated in 3.2.1.2.

in.overflight.v: overflying aircraft must quote a DGCA clearance or may be made to land
in.overflight.quote: Overflying aircraft that are unable to quote the authority are liable to make a landing in India

in.cabotage.v: international flights may not pick up passengers in India and set them down elsewhere in India
in.cabotage.quote: International flights are not permitted to pick up passengers/load at any place in India

in.customs_airports.v: first landing and final departure at an international aerodrome
in.customs_airports.quote: shall make their first landing at or final departure from,

in.notable.v: immigration and customs clearance on the General Declaration is required before departure
in.notable.quote: No flight shall leave India without obtaining clearance of Immigration and Custom authorities on General Declaration
